title: Burden of Cytomegalovirus Reactivation in Pediatric Patients After Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
official: CMV PED Study - A Retrospective Observational Study To Understand The Clinical And Economic Burden Associated With Cytomegalovirus Reactivation and Related Health Outcomes In Pediatric Patients Receiving Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation In Italy
summary: This observational retrospective analysis will provide useful information for clinicians and payers, and local guidelines committee members, to improve the understanding of Cytomegalovirus clinical and economic burden and clinical management of pediatric patients undergoing allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cells Transplantation in Italy.
